main.description: Upload an ebook file to the authenticated user's personal library. Accepts EPUB, MOBI/AZW/AZW3, FB2 (including .fb2.zip) and CBZ. The declared Content-Type is advisory only: the format is determined from the file's magic bytes checked against the `filename` extension, and a file that matches neither is rejected. `application/octet-stream` is accepted because mobile document pickers and plain curl uploads routinely send it.

filename.description: Original file name including extension. Required: the extension is the only thing distinguishing the zip-container formats (.epub / .cbz / .fb2.zip) from each other, and it is the key used to match e-reader sync documents to this file.

storageUsedBytes.description: Total bytes stored for this user after the upload

storageQuotaBytes.description: Total bytes this user is allowed to store

errors.name: UnsupportedFormat
errors.description: The bytes are not a recognised ebook, or do not match the filename's extension

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.description: A book with this content hash is already in the library

errors.name: TooLarge
errors.description: The file exceeds the per-file size limit

errors.name: QuotaExceeded
errors.description: The upload would take the library over its total storage quota

errors.name: Busy
errors.description: Too many uploads are being processed; retry shortly
